title: EvidenceEventBatch
description: The projection M5 emits onto the evidence bus for the Verified Skill Graph (M6). M6 does NOT consume discrepancies - it has no interest in fraud. It consumes corroborated capability signals, each carrying a reliability that determines how far it moves the latent-ability estimate. Emission is fire-and-forget: if the bus is down, verification still succeeds. The standalone product must not acquire a hard dependency on platform infrastructure.

verification_id.description: Back-reference to the VerificationReport every event derives from.

consent_scope.description: Purposes this data may be used for. M6 must refuse events whose scope does not cover skill-graph inclusion.

not_emitted.description: What M5 deliberately withheld and why. Makes the filtering auditable rather than invisible.

relevance.description: How much of this observation bears on this particular skill.

ReliabilityFactor.description: Every multiplier applied to the base reliability, named. Makes a capped value auditable instead of magic.

kind.description: cv_claim is self-reported and weak (reliability ~0.20). platform_rating comes from an authoritative API and is the strongest (~0.90). assessment_result is a sandboxed, auto-scored task from the assessment module: observed under a time limit, priced by M6 from the task's level and the share of hidden tests passed.

occurred_at.description: When the underlying activity happened, NOT when it was observed. This is what the decay kernel reads: sigma^2(t) = sigma^2(tau) + lambda_s * delta_t.

strength.description: How much signal this observation carries about ability.

reliability.description: Trustworthiness of the source, after all factors. Drives observation variance in M6's Bayesian update; corresponds to rho_k.

direction.description: negative lowers the estimate. Asymmetry rule: events from claimed_unverified identities may be negative at full reliability but are capped when positive.

module.description: The module that produced the evidence. Widened from a const when the assessment module began feeding the graph, as M6's design anticipated.

payload.description: Kind-specific detail, carried for explainability. M6 stores it on the evidence node so any score decomposes on demand.

reason.description: Employment/education discrepancies are not capability signals. D11/D12 are non-scoring by construction. A dead deployment link says nothing about skill.
